$comment: Voice conversation turn-taking contract (architecture §9.6, E-112..E-114; live captions, endpointing and echo gates revised by E-247, E-249, E-259..E-262). Every client implements runVad, isEcho, endsWithContinuation, joinAmend, reduce, displayState, statusKey and caption as pure functions (no IO, no clock, no randomness; time only comes from event atMs) and compares each case byte-exact with expected. vad: input.frames is run-length [[dBFS, frameCount], ...], expand before feeding. echo: compare echo exactly and overlap within 0.00005 (null when the transcript is not compared). continuation / amend: plain values. reduce: start from initialState(), fold input.events one by one; expected[i] is displayState, statusKey, caption, the effect list and nextDeadlineMs after event i.

vad: Input is one dBFS value per frameMs frame. Clamp every value to frameDbClampDb first (NaN and -Infinity become -120). All arithmetic is IEEE-754 double in exactly the order written here.

floor starts at floorInitDb. It is updated only on non-voiced frames: floor = floor + floorAlpha * (db - floor), then clamped to floorClampDb (lower bound -75: noise suppression's digital silence must not drag the floor to -90, E-247).

Not speaking: a frame is voiced iff db >= floor + vadStartOverFloorDb and db >= vadAbsoluteMinDb. A non-voiced frame resets the pending voiced run and updates the floor. The run needs vadStartMs / frameMs frames, bargeInMinSpeechMs / frameMs when the current frame is a candidate frame, or postPlaybackGuardMinSpeechMs / frameMs when the run's first frame lies in the post-playback guard window (S5·U3: 160 ms keeps one-syllable answers such as "No" right after playback; the measured echo tail is at most 2 frames). When it is reached emit {type:speechStart, frame, prerollFrame}: frame is the first frame of the run, prerollFrame = max(lowest, frame - vadPrerollMs / frameMs) where lowest = playbackEndedFrame when it is not null and frame >= playbackEndedFrame, else 0 (pre-roll never reaches back into playback, E-249 gate 2, every route). voicedMs starts at run length * frameMs.

Speaking: a frame is voiced iff db >= max(floor + vadContinueOverFloorDb, vadContinueAbsMinDb). A voiced frame adds frameMs to voicedMs and resets the silence count; a non-voiced frame adds one to the silence count and updates the floor. At vadEndSilenceMs / frameMs consecutive non-voiced frames the utterance closes at that frame with reason silence.

Length cap (per detector segment; a continued utterance is bounded by the caption stall instead): after a frame has been processed while speaking (including the frame that emitted speechStart) and the utterance did not close on silence, if frame - speechStart.frame + 1 >= vadMaxUtteranceMs / frameMs it closes at that frame with reason maxLength. The cap counts elapsed frames, pauses included.
Closing emits {type:speechEnd, frame, voicedMs, reason} when voicedMs >= vadMinUtteranceMs, else {type:discarded, frame}; then the detector is back to not speaking with silence and voicedMs at 0.

Candidate mode (barge-in candidate) applies only when opts.route is speaker and opts.playbackStartFrame is not null, to frames with index >= playbackStartFrame and (playbackEndedFrame is null or index < playbackEndedFrame). Headphones and bluetooth never use candidate mode.

Grace frames are candidate frames with index < playbackStartFrame + bargeInGraceMs / frameMs. They are skipped: no floor update, no voiced or silence counting, and a pending (not yet started) voiced run is reset to 0. A run crossing the end of the grace window starts at the first frame after it.

Post-playback guard window (E-249 gate 1): only when opts.route is speaker and opts.playbackEndedFrame is not null; frames playbackEndedFrame .. playbackEndedFrame + postPlaybackGuardMs / frameMs - 1. playbackEndedFrame is the real end of playback (iOS .dataPlayedBack; Android playback head plus output latency from AudioTrack.getTimestamp).

opts.resetFrame (the host executed a resetVad effect there): before that frame is processed the open utterance and the pending run are dropped without any event, silence and voicedMs become 0; the floor is kept. A speechStart may therefore follow an unclosed speechStart when resetFrame lies between them.
The end of the input emits nothing: an open utterance stays open (the host keeps feeding frames). Frame numbers never decrease.
Audio sent to STT is frames prerollFrame .. speechEnd.frame inclusive (the trailing silence is included).

Model mode (E-366): a frame may carry a voice probability from an on-device VAD model; the fixture writes it as a third run element [dBFS, frameCount, prob]. When the first frame carries prob the whole sequence runs in model mode (every frame carries prob); otherwise every energy rule above applies unchanged. Model mode changes only the floor and the voiced tests below; grace, candidate, bargeInMinSpeechMs, the post-playback guard, pre-roll, vadMinUtteranceMs, the length cap and resetFrame are exactly as above.

Model mode floor: keep the clamped db of every processed frame (grace frames are skipped and do not enter it; resetFrame keeps it). After pushing frame i, its smoothed value = the arithmetic mean of the db of the last floorSmoothMs / frameMs processed frames up to and including i (fewer when fewer exist), summed oldest first then divided by the count. The floor used for frame i = the minimum smoothed value among the last floorWindowMs / frameMs processed frames before i (frame i itself excluded), or floorInitDb when there is none. No floorAlpha and no floorClampDb. Voiced frames enter the floor too: speech pauses keep it at the noise level, so it cannot lock above the background. Background level (E-376): bg for frame i = the same buffer of smoothed values as the floor (frame i excluded) sorted ascending, element at index floor((n - 1) * vadModelBgPercentile / 100) where n is its size; floorInitDb when it is empty.

Model mode, not speaking: a frame is voiced iff prob >= vadModelStartProb and db >= max(vadAbsoluteMinDb, floor + vadModelGateOverFloorDb, startBg + vadModelStartOverBgDb), where startBg = bg except in the follow-up case below. On the frame where speechStart is emitted, bgAtStart = that frame's startBg (kept until the next speechStart; resetFrame does not change it). Speaking: a frame is voiced iff prob >= vadModelContinueProb and smoothed >= max(floor + vadModelContinueOverFloorDb, bgAtStart + vadModelContinueOverBgDb), where smoothed = frame i's smoothed value (the mean including frame i, as defined above). A TV or radio with speech keeps prob high, so the background gate keeps it from starting an utterance and from holding one open; a long monologue raises bg but not bgAtStart, so it does not end early. Run, start, silence counting and closing follow the energy rules above.

Model mode follow-up after a pause (E-415): when an utterance closes with speechEnd (not discarded) at frame c, remember lastBgAtStart = its bgAtStart and lastCloseFrame = c; resetFrame keeps both (E-708: resetVad at playback start must not make a barge-in right after the user's own utterance face the background level that utterance raised). While not speaking at frame i, if lastCloseFrame exists, i - lastCloseFrame <= floorWindowMs / frameMs and floor <= lastBgAtStart + vadModelFollowUpFloorOverBgDb (the pause really went quiet), startBg = min(bg, lastBgAtStart); otherwise startBg = bg. The utterance just before the pause raised bg to its own level, so without this the second half of a paused sentence would not start; a TV that keeps playing through the pause keeps the floor high, so it gets no relief.

Model mode onset backtrack (E-413): while not speaking, when a non-voiced frame interrupts a pending voiced run (model start test above) of at least vadModelOnsetMinRunFrames frames whose first frame is not a candidate frame, record the run's first frame (a run that starts while the reply plays on the speaker is most likely echo, so a barge-in never backtracks into it); keep only records with i - first <= vadModelOnsetBacktrackMs / frameMs, where i is the current frame. Grace frames, resetFrame, forceEndFrame and the speechStart that ends a run record nothing; resetFrame, forceEndFrame and every speechStart clear the records. On the frame i where speechStart is emitted, onset = min(frame, the earliest record with i - first <= vadModelOnsetBacktrackMs / frameMs) (frame when there is none) and prerollFrame = max(lowest, onset - vadPrerollMs / frameMs) with lowest as above; speechStart.frame and the start decision are unchanged. A loud TV floor delays the start decision past a short leading syllable split off by a comma pause; this restores it into the audio sent to STT. Energy mode is unchanged.
echo: isEcho(transcript, pool) returns {echo, overlap}. pool holds, in play order, the reply sentences that started playing (sentenceStarted) and the app prompts that played (promptStarted) since the last reply request; their units are concatenated into one sequence.

Units: normalize with NFKC, then full Unicode lowercase (locale-independent: JS toLowerCase, Kotlin lowercase(), Swift lowercased()). Walk code points (not grapheme clusters). A maximal run of Chinese numeral characters (零〇一二两三四五六七八九十百千万亿) is converted first (next rule) and each character of the result is its own unit. A code point whose General_Category (Unicode 15.1) is P*, S*, Z*, Cc or Cf or a variation selector (U+FE00..U+FE0F, U+E0100..U+E01EF) is a separator and is dropped. ASCII digits 0-9 (full-width digits become ASCII under NFKC) and code points inside a singleUnitRanges range (Han, kana, Hangul) are each their own unit. Every other maximal run of code points is one unit; separators split runs before they are removed ("hello world" is two units, "helloworld" one).

Chinese numeral run: without a digit character (零〇一二两三四五六七八九) it stays as is. Without a unit character (十百千万亿) every digit maps to 0-9 (零 and 〇 are 0, 两 is 2): 二零二六 -> 2026. Otherwise positional, in 64-bit integers: total = section = num = 0, hasNum = false; digit d: num = d, hasNum = true; 十 / 百 / 千 (10 / 100 / 1000): section += (hasNum ? num : 1) * unit, num = 0, hasNum = false; 万: total += (section + num) * 10000, section = num = 0, hasNum = false; 亿: total = (total + section + num) * 100000000, section = num = 0, hasNum = false. The value total + section + num is written in decimal (一千零五 -> 1005, 三万五千 -> 35000); as soon as total, section or the final value exceeds 2^53 - 1 the run stays as is (checked after every character, so no implementation overflows).

singleUnitRanges: U+0E00..U+0E7F (Thai is written without spaces), U+1100..U+11FF, U+2E80..U+2FDF, U+3005, U+3007, U+3021..U+3029, U+3038..U+303B, U+3040..U+30FF, U+3130..U+318F, U+31F0..U+31FF, U+3400..U+4DBF, U+4E00..U+9FFF, U+A960..U+A97F, U+AC00..U+D7FF, U+F900..U+FAFF, U+FF66..U+FF9F, U+FFA0..U+FFDC, U+1B000..U+1B16F, U+20000..U+3FFFF.

Minimum length (E-259): a transcript unit inside singleUnitRanges weighs echoHanUnitWeight, any other unit echoOtherUnitWeight. With zero units or total weight < echoMinWeight (fewer than 4 CJK characters / 3 words) the transcript is not compared: {echo:false, overlap:null}.

L = length of the longest run of consecutive units that appears identically in both the transcript and the pool sequence. ratio = L / transcriptUnits as a double. echo = ratio >= echoOverlapRatio (3/5 equals the literal 0.6). overlap = floor(ratio * 10000 + 0.5) / 10000 (half rounds up, not to even). An empty pool gives overlap 0.

Known trade-off (E-259): a quick answer quoting the reply ("我要去公园" after "你想去公园还是博物馆？") reaches 0.6 and is dropped with a nudge; case echo_quote_answer_dropped_known_tradeoff locks it until S5 data says otherwise.
Fixtures avoid Greek capital sigma and Turkish dotted I, where platform lowercasing may differ, and code points added after Unicode 12, which older platform tables classify as unassigned.

White space (continuation, amend) is exactly Unicode White_Space: U+0009..U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000..U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000. U+FEFF and U+001C..U+001F are not white space (they are separators). Do not use the platform trim.
continuation: endsWithContinuation(text): strip trailing Unicode white space; empty -> false. True when the last code point is in continuationPunctuation (raw text, before NFKC). False when it is any other separator (rules.echo; a full stop or question mark ends the sentence). Otherwise true when the echo units of some continuationWords entry equal the last units of echoUnits(text) (so "Android" does not end with "and"). Otherwise false.
amend: joinAmend(previous, text): strip trailing white space of previous and leading white space of text. Empty text -> previous; empty previous -> text. When the last code point of previous or the first code point of text is inside singleUnitRanges the two are concatenated, otherwise joined with one space. The host uses it for amendLastMessage.
state: initialState(): phase idle, route speaker, speakerBargeIn true, every other flag false, counters 0, timestamps and ids null, partialText empty, pool empty, notice null. Phases: idle | listening | thinking | speaking | ended.

reduce(state, event) returns {state, effects}. It never mutates its input. Unknown event types, and every event while phase is ended, return the state unchanged with no effects. While phase is idle only start is accepted.
In listening, thinking and speaking, every accepted-type event other than deadline sets lastActivityMs = atMs (even when the event is otherwise dropped). In idle and ended nothing changes.

Utterance fields: userSpeaking, utteranceStartMs (atMs of the accepted vadSpeechStart), partialText, partialChangedAtMs, stallFired, the hold (utteranceId, voicedMs, silenceStartMs, sinceMs), the continuation (continuedUtteranceId, continuedVoicedMs) and forcedByTap (the utterance was ended by tapOrb's forceEndUtterance). Clearing the utterance resets all of them.

Turn reset (on entering listening and on entering thinking) clears the utterance, playbackStopped, sttAttempts, awaitedUtteranceId, utteranceVoicedMs, utteranceCompared, heardPending, amend, bargeIn, reply (none), drained, thinkingSinceMs and thinkingEarconPlayed. Entering thinking sets thinkingSinceMs = atMs. Entering listening sets lastActivityMs = atMs and emits resetVad{playbackEndedAtMs} where the value is playbackEndedAtMs when atMs - playbackEndedAtMs < postPlaybackGuardMs, else null.

Kept across turns: route, speakerBargeIn, falseBargeIns, playbackEndedAtMs, the echo pool, emptyStreak, languageHintShown, notice and the host flags (muted, awaitingApproval, interrupted, screenReaderSpeaking, messagePlaying, promptPlaying).

playbackEndedAtMs = atMs of the latest real playback end: playbackDrained, every stopPlayback effect, messagePlaybackEnded and promptEnded. The echo pool gains the text of sentenceStarted and promptStarted and is emptied when a new reply is requested (sendMessage, amendLastMessage).
speakerBargeIn = route != speaker || !(deviceRemembersNoSpeakerBargeIn || falseBargeIns >= falseBargeInsPerConversation). It is recomputed on start, routeChanged and when the echo limit is reached.

A reply is in flight from sendMessage / amendLastMessage until replyCompleted, replyFailed or cancelGeneration. The host must not forward events of a cancelled generation; the reducer additionally drops replySentence, replyCompleted and replyFailed when no reply is streaming.

canFinalize: phase listening, or thinking with amend, or speaking with bargeIn. Echo window (E-259), evaluated when an utterance is finalized: compared iff route is speaker and (phase is speaking, or utteranceStartMs - playbackEndedAtMs <= echoWindowMs with both set).

Reply audio gate (E-367): finalize sets gateAt = the utterance's silence start + replyAudioGateMs (vadSpeechEnd and a hold finalized by deadline: the hold silenceStartMs; vadDiscarded keeping a continued sentence: atMs - vadEndSilenceMs; a hold finalized by tapOrb, or any utterance with forcedByTap: null, no gate; a caption-stall forceEndUtterance keeps the gate). The message is still sent at once. In thinking while atMs < gateAt, replySentence texts are queued in arrival order (no enqueueSpeech) and replyCompleted, when sentences are queued, is queued after them. Flush (deadline at or after gateAt, or a replySentence / replyCompleted at or after gateAt): phase speaking; unless playbackStopped drained = false and one enqueueSpeech{text} per queued text in order; the queue empties, gateAt = null; a queued replyCompleted then sets reply completed and runs the finish check. vadSpeechStart in thinking before the flush takes the existing amend path and also clears the queue, the queued replyCompleted and gateAt. Turn reset empties the queue and the queued replyCompleted; entering listening also sets gateAt = null. A gate already passed changes nothing.
events: start{route, deviceRemembersNoSpeakerBargeIn}: only from idle. Phase listening, effects startCapture, earcon{kind:start}, haptic{kind:light}. route is speaker | headphones | bluetooth (anything else is speaker).

VAD events (vadSpeechStart, vadSpeechEnd, vadDiscarded, bargeInDetected) are dropped while muted, interrupted, screenReaderSpeaking, messagePlaying or promptPlaying; in phase speaking when a transcription is awaited, or when !speakerBargeIn and !userSpeaking (an utterance already open may still close after a route change); in phase thinking when no transcription is awaited, no reply is streaming and !userSpeaking. In phase thinking while a transcription is awaited (E-412), vadSpeechStart / vadSpeechEnd / vadDiscarded are not dropped but appended unchanged (atMs, utteranceId) to pendingVad with no effects; a vadDiscarded whose queue tail is a vadSpeechStart removes that tail instead (noise start does not interrupt). After an accepted sttResult / sttFailed is handled, if the state is no longer thinking-with-a-transcription-awaited the queue empties and its events are replayed once in order through the same reduce on the new state, their effects appended after this event's; while still awaited (retry) the queue stays. lastActivityMs after the replay is this event's atMs. The queue empties on turn reset, on end and wherever the open utterance is abandoned (muting, interruptionBegan, screenReaderSpeaking, promptStarted).

vadSpeechStart: while a hold is open -> effect continueUtterance{utteranceId: hold id}; continuedUtteranceId = hold id, continuedVoicedMs = hold voicedMs; if partialText is non-empty partialChangedAtMs = atMs; the hold closes, stallFired = false, forcedByTap = false (the host keeps the same utterance id and audio). Else if already userSpeaking -> nothing. Else userSpeaking = true, utteranceStartMs = atMs, notice = null; in phase thinking also amend = true, reply none, the reply audio gate is cleared (queue, queued replyCompleted, gateAt) and effect cancelGeneration (E-260: speaking while it thinks stops generation).

vadSpeechEnd{utteranceId, voicedMs}: dropped unless userSpeaking and no hold is open. If !canFinalize the utterance is cleared and nothing else happens. Otherwise open a hold {utteranceId, voicedMs: (continuedVoicedMs or 0) + (event voicedMs or 0), silenceStartMs: atMs - vadEndSilenceMs, sinceMs: atMs}; when partialText is empty or holdUntil <= atMs, finalize immediately with the hold values.

holdUntil (E-260): cap = silenceStartMs + endpointMaxSilenceMs. endsWithContinuation(partialText) -> cap; else min(cap, max(sinceMs, partialChangedAtMs + endpointPartialSettleMs)). It is recomputed from the current partial, so captions arriving during the hold push it out, never past cap.

Finalize(utteranceId, voicedMs): compared = echo window; in listening enter thinking (turn reset); otherwise clear the utterance, and in thinking (an amend) thinkingSinceMs = atMs (the thinking clock restarts). awaitedUtteranceId = utteranceId, sttAttempts = 1, utteranceVoicedMs = voicedMs (0 when missing), utteranceCompared = heardPending = compared, gateAt per the reply audio gate. Effects: earcon{kind:heard}, haptic{kind:light} unless compared (then they wait for the echo check, E-259), then transcribe{utteranceId}.

vadDiscarded: dropped unless userSpeaking and no hold is open. If continuedUtteranceId is set and canFinalize: finalize(continuedUtteranceId, continuedVoicedMs) (a short noise after resuming keeps the sentence). Otherwise abandon.

Abandon (mute, interruptionBegan after setting interrupted, screenReaderSpeaking true, promptStarted, vadDiscarded): wasAmending = amend && userSpeaking; clear the utterance; if wasAmending regenerate with empty text; else if phase speaking, bargeIn and no transcription awaited: bargeIn = false, effect resumePlayback{from:pausePoint} unless playbackStopped or interrupted, then the finish check.
Regenerate(text): effect amendLastMessage{text}, enter thinking (turn reset), reply streaming, pool emptied. Empty text means: regenerate the previous user message unchanged.
bargeInDetected: only in speaking, when userSpeaking, speakerBargeIn and not already bargeIn. bargeIn = true, effect pausePlayback unless playbackStopped.
sttPartial{text}: dropped unless userSpeaking (hold included). If text differs from partialText: partialText = text, partialChangedAtMs = atMs, stallFired = false. No effect.

sttResult{utteranceId, text} and sttFailed{utteranceId} are dropped unless utteranceId == awaitedUtteranceId (late results after a cancel are ignored). On sttResult awaitedUtteranceId = null; empty = text has zero echo units; echo = !empty && utteranceCompared && isEcho(text, pool).echo.

sttResult with bargeIn: empty or echo -> bargeIn = false, heardPending = false, effect resumePlayback{from:sentenceStart} unless playbackStopped, then the echo count, then the finish check. Otherwise the pending heard pair, cancelGeneration, sendMessage{text}; enter thinking, reply streaming, sent.
sttResult with amend: empty or echo -> [nudgeOrb if echo], regenerate with empty text. Otherwise the pending heard pair, regenerate with text, sent.

sttResult otherwise: empty -> miss. echo -> echo count, enter listening. Else the pending heard pair, effect sendMessage{text} (text unchanged), reply streaming, sent. When the miss emitted speakPrompt{sayAgain | checkLanguage} and, after the queued VAD replay (E-412), userSpeaking is true or awaitedUtteranceId is not null, that speakPrompt and its haptic are removed from the effects (the host playing a prompt would void the next utterance being recorded or just closed; then notice = null, and languageHintShown = false when the removed prompt was checkLanguage, so a later miss can still prompt; emptyStreak stays as the miss set it).

Echo count (E-249 gate 5): effect nudgeOrb; only on route speaker falseBargeIns += 1, and when it reaches falseBargeInsPerConversation speakerBargeIn becomes false and effects rememberFalseBargeInConversation, speakPrompt{prompt:echoHint} follow.
Sent: emptyStreak = 0, notice = null, pool emptied. The pending heard pair is earcon{kind:heard}, haptic{kind:light} when heardPending, then heardPending = false.

Miss (E-261): v = utteranceVoicedMs; enter listening; if v >= checkLanguageMinVoicedMs then emptyStreak += 1; if v < sayAgainMinVoicedMs nothing more (noise never prompts). Else if emptyStreak >= checkLanguageAfterMisses and !languageHintShown: languageHintShown = true, notice = checkLanguage; otherwise notice = sayAgain. Effects speakPrompt{prompt: notice}, haptic{kind:light}.

sttFailed: if sttAttempts <= sttRetries then sttAttempts += 1 and effect transcribe{utteranceId}. Otherwise with amend: regenerate with empty text. Otherwise effects [cancelGeneration if bargeIn], speakPrompt{prompt:didNotCatch}, haptic{kind:light}, enter listening; speakPrompt and haptic are left out when, after the queued VAD replay (E-412), userSpeaking is true (the user is already talking). Nothing is written to the pending-transcription slot (D-35).

replySentence{text}: only while the reply is streaming, in thinking or speaking. In thinking before gateAt it is queued (reply audio gate) and nothing else happens; otherwise flush the gate queue first, then phase speaking; unless playbackStopped: drained = false and effect enqueueSpeech{text}.
sentenceStarted{text} (host: a queued sentence began playing): only in speaking; text joins the echo pool.

replyCompleted: in thinking before gateAt with sentences queued it is queued (reply audio gate); otherwise flush the gate queue first, then reply completed; in thinking enter listening immediately, in speaking run the finish check. playbackDrained (queue empty and audio really finished): only in speaking; drained = true, playbackEndedAtMs = atMs, then the finish check.
Finish check: phase speaking && reply completed && (drained || playbackStopped) && !bargeIn -> enter listening.
replyFailed{code}: only while streaming. error = true, phase ended, effect endConversation{reason:error, code}.
approvalPending: accepted in any active phase. If not already set: awaitingApproval = true, effect speakPrompt{prompt:approvalNeeded}. approvalResolved clears it, no effect.

tapOrb: awaitingApproval -> nothing. muted && listening -> same as toggleMute. Hold open -> finalize it now. listening, or thinking while userSpeaking: if userSpeaking forcedByTap = true and effect forceEndUtterance, else nothing. thinking: nothing while atMs - thinkingSinceMs < listenToThinkTapGuardMs (E-24, 599 ignored, 600 acts), else effect cancelGeneration and enter listening. speaking: unless playbackStopped, stop playback (playbackStopped = true, playbackEndedAtMs = atMs, effect stopPlayback), then the finish check (text keeps generating; later sentences are not enqueued).
toggleMute: flip muted, effect setCaptureMuted{muted}; muting then abandons the utterance. Capture input is never closed.

deadline (host fires it once at nextDeadlineMs; there is no periodic tick, E-222), first matching rule only: hold open -> finalize when atMs >= holdUntil. Caption stall (userSpeaking, no hold, canFinalize, partialText non-empty, !stallFired) -> when atMs >= partialChangedAtMs + partialStallMs: stallFired = true, effect forceEndUtterance (E-247). thinking with sentences queued && atMs >= gateAt -> flush the reply audio gate. listening && idle-quiet (!muted, !userSpeaking, !awaitingApproval, !interrupted, !screenReaderSpeaking, !messagePlaying) && atMs - lastActivityMs >= idleTimeoutMs -> effects earcon{kind:end}, haptic{kind:light}, endConversation{reason:idle}, phase ended. otherwise thinking && !thinkingEarconPlayed && !awaitingApproval && !interrupted && !userSpeaking && atMs - thinkingSinceMs >= thinkingEarconMs -> effect earcon{kind:thinking}, once per turn.

nextDeadlineMs(state) mirrors the deadline rules in the same order: holdUntil; partialChangedAtMs + partialStallMs; lastActivityMs + idleTimeoutMs; in thinking the earlier of gateAt (when sentences are queued) and thinkingSinceMs + thinkingEarconMs (when the earcon is pending); otherwise null (also null when the needed timestamp is null). A deadline before it changes nothing; a deadline at or after it fires its rule.

interruptionBegan (if not already): interrupted = true, effects [pausePlayback if speaking and !playbackStopped], pauseCapture, then abandon. interruptionEnded (if set): interrupted = false; if speaking and !playbackStopped then stop playback (playback never auto-resumes after a call); effect resumeCapture; then the finish check.
screenReaderSpeaking{speaking}: sets the flag; true also abandons the utterance. VAD events are dropped while it is set (D-38).
routeChanged{route}: recompute speakerBargeIn. Leaving a private route (headphones / bluetooth) for speaker while speaking and !playbackStopped: stop playback, then the finish check.

playMessage{messageId} (D-37): only in listening, not interrupted, not already playing. messagePlaying = true, the utterance is cleared, effects pauseCapture, playMessage{messageId}. messagePlaybackEnded (if playing): messagePlaying = false, playbackEndedAtMs = atMs, effect resumeCapture, then resetVad{playbackEndedAtMs: atMs} in listening.

promptStarted{text} (host: a speakPrompt began playing; ignored while one is playing): promptPlaying = true, text joins the echo pool, then abandon. promptEnded (if playing): promptPlaying = false, playbackEndedAtMs = atMs, effect resetVad{playbackEndedAtMs: atMs} in listening.

end{reason}: reason user | system (anything else is system). Effects [transcribeToDraft if reason user and userSpeaking (an open hold included)], earcon{kind:end}, haptic{kind:light}, endConversation{reason}; phase ended.
display: displayState: error if error; null in idle or ended; else awaitingApproval; else muted if muted && phase listening; else userSpeaking if userSpeaking && canFinalize; else notice (sayAgain | checkLanguage) when phase listening and notice is set; else the phase (listening | thinking | speaking).

statusKey = displayState, except: userSpeaking -> caption when partialText is non-empty, else listening (the orb already reacts, the text waits for the first word); speaking with route speaker and !speakerBargeIn -> speakingTapToInterrupt. Ids: listening, caption, thinking, speaking, speakingTapToInterrupt, muted, awaitingApproval, sayAgain, checkLanguage, error.

caption = partialText when statusKey is caption, else null. The UI shows it in the status slot on up to two lines with head ellipsis (newest words always visible), measured with the displayed style (tracking included) and cut on grapheme-cluster boundaries. Newest words use the body color, earlier ones dim, split by captionHighlight: text with a Han / Hiragana / Katakana / Hangul character (punctuation does not count) → take grapheme clusters from the end until their scalar count reaches captionBrightScalars; otherwise whitespace-separated words, <= captionBrightWords → all bright, else bright from the captionBrightWords-th word from the end (the whitespace before it is dim). No trimming.

sayAgain is the amber status 没听清，再说一次 (p2-copy voice_conversation_status_say_again); checkLanguage is the shorter amber status 没听清 (p2-copy voice_conversation_status_check_language) plus the separate capsule button for the recognition language (E-263, E-275). The UI reads only displayState / statusKey / caption; it never derives state on its own (E-114).
host: The host turns real signals into events and executes effects in list order. cancelGeneration cancels the in-flight reply or transcription and discards its queued or paused speech.

resetVad{playbackEndedAtMs}: reset the detector as in rules.vad resetFrame; when the value is not null, run the post-playback guard window from the real end of playback (rules.vad playbackEndedFrame; never earlier than playbackEndedAtMs). Event atMs stays the monotonic now; the host keeps the measured real end separately (Android system TTS: AudioTrack.getTimestamp extrapolated to the last written frame; Android cloud TTS: MediaPlayer onCompletion + 150 ms). Android SelfRecord (the recognizer records by itself, E-249 gate 4): call startListening only once postPlaybackGuardMs have passed since that real end; its result still goes through sttResult and the echo check, and its voicedMs is the recognizer's onBeginningOfSpeech -> onEndOfSpeech span (an empty result is still reported, so sayAgain / checkLanguage work on this path).

continueUtterance{utteranceId}: the speech that just resumed belongs to that utterance; the host keeps the live recognizer session (or the audio buffer) and reports the next vadSpeechEnd with the same id. forceEndUtterance: make the detector close the open utterance now (it emits speechEnd).

earcon kinds (stepped sine segments, phase continuous, -18 dBFS, 10 ms fade in at the start and 10 ms fade out at the end of the whole earcon): start 660 Hz 60 ms + 880 Hz 60 ms; heard 880 Hz 60 ms; thinking 880 Hz 120 ms; end 660 Hz 110 ms + 440 Hz 130 ms. haptic light: iOS UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(.light), Android HapticFeedbackConstants.CONFIRM (KEYBOARD_TAP below API 30); both follow the system haptics switch. nudgeOrb: one short orb shake, no text, no sound.
amendLastMessage{text}: replace the last user message with joinAmend(it, text) in the same bubble and regenerate the reply; empty text regenerates it unchanged.

bargeInDetected: the host sends it right after vadSpeechStart for every speechStart detected while reply audio is playing (on speaker the detector already required bargeInMinSpeechMs in candidate mode). Reply audio is playing from the first sentence's start until playbackDrained of a completed reply, stopPlayback or pausePlayback, gaps between queued sentences included (a drain while the reply is still streaming keeps the window and its grace start); playbackStartFrame (and so the grace window) is set once when a reply starts playing and once after each resumePlayback, not per sentence.

speakPrompt prompts: queued behind reply audio that is playing or resumed in the same effect list, never mixed with it: a prompt plays right after the sentence that is playing ends, before the rest of the reply, and prompts play first in first out; in listening they play at once. Prompts: didNotCatch, approvalNeeded, sayAgain, checkLanguage (spoken without the language name, E-263), echoHint. The host reports the spoken text with promptStarted / promptEnded. Live recognizer sessions (cascade, system engine): stop at transcribe and wait at most 1500 ms for the final result (a bound, not the E-262 target); empty, failed or late -> recognize the same audio from file once; that utterance counts as one attempt with the final outcome.
rememberFalseBargeInConversation: the host counts such conversations per device; after conversationsToRemember of them it starts later conversations with deviceRemembersNoSpeakerBargeIn = true.

Page reachability (both engines): the voice bar on the home page only ever shows pageReachableStatusKeys.home; speaking always happens on the chat page because the host has already moved there (cascade: first sendMessage, D-24; realtime: first turn event, realtime-conversation rules.host).
Host only: create the chat on the first sendMessage from the home screen (D-24); ignore the voice button for stopToVoiceGuardMs after it turns back from stop (E-24).

Timers (E-222): no periodic tick. After every reduce the host reads nextDeadlineMs(state); when it differs from the armed value the host cancels the armed one-shot timer and, if non-null, arms one that dispatches deadline{atMs: now} once at that time (immediately when already past). It never polls. atMs uses one monotonic clock for all events.

Latency targets (E-262; measured in S5, not fixture cases): dictation speech -> first word <= 1.2 s; endpoint decision -> earcon / orb change <= 100 ms; decision -> final transcript on screen <= 1.0 s; end of speech -> first reply audio p50 <= 2.5 s, p95 <= 4 s (non-reasoning model, system TTS, Wi-Fi); reasoning models have no first-audio target and rely on the thinking earcon; tap -> ready to talk <= 300 ms; speech -> orb follows <= 100 ms; barge-in -> playback stops <= 300 ms.

Host only (S4·U3): while the screen reader is speaking, captured frames are not fed to the VAD (the noise floor is frozen) and the open utterance and its live session are closed at once. A live session that dropped queued audio (overflow) is not trusted: the utterance is recognized from its recording file, same as dictationOutcome with droppedAudio. A recognition call that throws a non-recognizer error counts as an sttFailed attempt with condition thrown (failure_kind other).

Output route (E-374): map the platform's output device list to speaker | headphones | bluetooth by group outputRoute. Only devices known to sit at the ear count as headphones; bluetooth stays its own route; everything else (built-in speaker, car audio, AirPlay, HDMI / DisplayPort, casting / remote submix, line out, docks, USB devices, unknown) is speaker. Android passes all connected outputs (AudioManager.getDevices(GET_DEVICES_OUTPUTS)), which always include the earpiece and speaker, so the earpiece is not headphones there; iOS passes the current route's outputs, where builtInReceiver is headphones. Priority bluetooth > headphones > speaker. Names are AudioDeviceInfo TYPE_* constant names (android) and AVAudioSession.Port Swift member names (ios).
